// A sibling `tests.rs` carries no `#[cfg(test)]` of its own: the parent
// declares it. The whole file is test code.
use super::*;

#[test]
fn sibling_file_is_test_context() {
    unsafe { std::env::set_var("SIBLING_FILE", "1") };
}

#[test]
#[serial_test::serial(sibling_env)]
fn a_hand_restored_call_is_reported() {
    unsafe { std::env::set_var("SIBLING_JUSTIFIED", "1") }; // env-ok: serialised by serial(sibling_env)
}

// The permitted shape: the raw mutation is the guard's OWN body, so the
// restore is bound to a drop instead of written out by hand.
fn sibling_env_guard(key: &'static str) -> EnvGuard {
    unsafe { std::env::set_var(key, "SIBLING_GUARDED") }; // env-ok: restored when the guard drops
    EnvGuard(key)
}

#[test]
fn a_hand_rolled_exec_write_is_reported() {
    std::fs::set_permissions("sibling-stub", std::fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o755)).unwrap();
}

#[test]
fn a_marked_mode_is_not_reported() {
    // exec-writer-ok: 0o700 on a directory, which is never exec'd.
    std::fs::set_permissions("gnupghome", std::fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o700)).unwrap();
}

#[test]
fn an_open_options_exec_write_is_reported() {
    let _ = std::fs::OpenOptions::new().mode(0o755).write(true).open("opts-stub");
}

// A marker is read from the COMMENT half of the line. Every pair below is
// one genuine marker and one spelled inside a string literal, which is code.
#[test]
fn a_forged_env_marker_is_reported() {
    let _guard = EnvGuard("FORGED_ENV_GUARD");
    unsafe { std::env::set_var("FORGED_ENV", "// env-ok: fake") };
}

#[test]
#[serial_test::serial(cwd)]
fn a_marked_cwd_swap_is_not_reported() {
    std::env::set_current_dir("marked").unwrap(); // cwd-ok: serialised by serial(cwd)
}

#[test]
fn a_forged_cwd_marker_is_reported() {
    std::env::set_current_dir("forged").unwrap_or_else(|_| panic!("// cwd-ok: fake"));
}

#[test]
fn a_forged_exec_writer_marker_is_reported() {
    std::fs::set_permissions("forged-stub", std::fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o755)).expect("// exec-writer-ok: fake");
}

#[test]
fn a_marked_spawn_is_not_reported() {
    let _ = Command::new("git").arg("marked").output(); // spawn-retry-ok: an availability probe
}

#[test]
fn a_forged_spawn_retry_marker_is_reported() {
    let _ = Command::new("git").arg("// spawn-retry-ok: fake").output();
}
